title: Ex-Pak PM Imran Khan returns to jail after medical examination at Islamabad hospital

title: 'U-turn in a week': DMK slams Vijay over delimitation stance after Shah meeting

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: In a heartbreaking turn of events, a young woman and her infant were allegedly killed by her in-laws after they demanded a luxury SUV as dowry, subjecting her to escalating violence. Following a fierce disagreement, she returned to her marital home bearing gifts, only to suffer further abuse. The authorities are actively investigating the tragic deaths, with her husband in custody for further inquiries.
title: Dowry case against 11 after woman, son killed in Haryana

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Rafael Nadal’s greatest lesson may sit beyond his 22 Grand Slam titles. From Uncle Toni’s strict training to the support of his parents, sister and wife Mery, family shaped the champion he became. Nadal always remained connected to Mallorca and wanted to be remembered as a good person. His story shows how discipline, gratitude and family can shape greatness.
title: How Rafael Nadal’s family and Uncle Toni shaped his tennis greatness

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Brittany Mahomes has built a career that extends well beyond her connection to Patrick Mahomes. After retiring from professional soccer in 2017, she became a certified fitness trainer and launched Brittany Lynne Fitness. She later joined the ownership group of the Kansas City Current, while expanding her profile through social media and brand partnerships. Her journey reflects how she turned athletic experience into opportunities across fitness, entrepreneurship and women's sports.
title: Brittany Mahomes builds $15 million business empire beyond Patrick Mahomes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Captain America star Chris Evans has found a buyer for his Los Angeles home after relisting the Hollywood Hills property for $6.39 million. Evans initially listed it for $6.99 million in 2025. He purchased the 1940s-era residence for $3.52 million in 2013 and is now selling it as he moves back East.
title: Chris Evans finds buyer for LA home listed at $6.39M after buying for $3.52M in 2013

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Friday, oil prices held steady, with Brent crude nearing $94 per barrel amid ongoing supply disruptions triggered by the US-Iran conflict. Both Brent and WTI benchmarks are poised for a second consecutive weekly increase. President Trump earlier issued threats of retaliation against nations backing Iran, as the ongoing war has resulted in significant casualties and interruptions to oil and gas supplies.
title: Brent hovers near $94 as US-Iran conflict continues to squeeze energy supply

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: The CEO of IBM took the bold step of revealing a financial deficit to stakeholders, triggering a notable decline in stock prices. This transparency caused clients to halt infrastructure advancements in favor of buying data center hardware. Krishna noted that distractions from rising AI trends and supply limitations were crucial factors. He is convinced that promptly revealing issues enables a sharper focus on strategic remedies.
title: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna on letter that sent stock down 25%, ‘worst day’ in history

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: Express train kills 4 workers carrying out weed-control work on tracks in Japan

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Stuart Broad called Pakistan a poor side and expects England to win the series. Pakistan's batting struggled, being bowled out for 171 on the first day. England then took a significant first-innings lead of 195 runs. Several England batters scored half-centuries, with Harry Brook narrowly missing a century. Broad's comments add pressure on Pakistan to recover in the ongoing contest.
title: 'Pakistan a poor side': Former England great delivers blunt verdict

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The United States is preparing unprecedented sanctions against Iran. These measures aim to increase economic pressure on Tehran significantly. Washington also seeks cooperation from China regarding Iranian oil trade. China rejects sanctions and advocates for diplomatic solutions to the conflict. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical point in this ongoing dispute.
title: US vows toughest-ever Iran sanctions, presses China to help reopen Hormuz

author: U SUDHAKAR REDDY
description: Madhapur police booked Lingamaneni Sanjush, son of MP Lingamaneni Ramesh, for rash driving. His Aston Martin allegedly killed a 26-year-old mall employee near Inorbit Mall on August 16. The victim, Bharati Mukhi, was crossing the road when the speeding car hit her severely. Sanjush, who tested negative for alcohol and drugs, rushed her to the hospital. Police registered a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for causing death by negligence.
title: Rajya Sabha member's son in soup after Aston Martin crash kills woman in Hyderabad

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an ambitious effort to rejuvenate the ecosystem, Utah wildlife officials undertook the removal of nearly all fish from Strawberry Reservoir in 1990. This strategic chemical operation was designed to halt the deterioration of the lake's environment. Following the fish removal, biologists introduced native trout to reinvigorate the food web and support recreational fishing. Enhanced barriers and regulations now safeguard this restored aquatic habitat, exemplifying effective freshwater management.
title: Utah's 1990 record rotenone killed 99% fish, now 715K catches a year

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' has emerged as a blockbuster sensation, raking in over 113 crore rupees in just one week. Leveraging the buzz of the Independence Day holiday, the film has maintained impressive momentum, heralding a remarkable resurgence for the actor. This achievement positions the film among the most lucrative post-COVID releases during the Independence Day weekend.
title: 'Awarapan 2' day 7: Rs 113cr week 1, 151% ROI, declared a hit

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: Questions Gang Charts, Prolonged Detention Without Defined Offence
title: SC faults UP Gangsters Act, says it is prone to misuse

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The conversation surrounding the religious undertones of Vande Mataram has reignited. Esteemed actress Sharmila Tagore voiced her apprehensions regarding its acceptance by followers of monotheistic religions. In contrast, Kangana Ranaut interpreted the verses as powerful symbols, advocating for an inclusive understanding that transcends religious boundaries. This dialogue underscores the historical importance and national identity encapsulated in Vande Mataram.
title: 'Shocked': Kangana reacts to Sharmila Tagore's 'Vande Mataram' comment

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: In a groundbreaking achievement, Joe Root has scored 3,000 runs as captain in the World Test Championship, marking a historic moment during England's first Test against Pakistan at Headingley. Root's remarkable batting skills have firmly established him atop the WTC captaincy run charts. His stellar performance has not only propelled England to a commanding first-innings advantage but also reinforces his legacy in Test cricket.
title: Joe Root scripts history, becomes first player to achieve this feat

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: After a remarkable 28-year campaign, Tasmania's fisheries service has successfully eliminated invasive common carp from Lake Sorell and Lake Crescent. This effort has seen the removal of over 49,000 harmful fish, leading to clearer waters and the revival of native plant life in marsh areas. The resurgence of wild brown trout has also enhanced recreational fishing opportunities for anglers, proving that large lakes can recover from invasive species.
title: Tasmania declares carp eradicated after 28-year removal of 49,000 fish, trout rebound

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Scientists discover nearly 400 fossils in France revealing life near the South Pole

author: SOUMITRA BOSE
description: A gangster died from stab wounds after a violent street fight.  He had gatecrashed a party where his rival was with his girlfriend.  The two men argued and fought for nearly thirty minutes.  The rival then snatched a knife and fatally stabbed the victim.  Police apprehended the accused at the scene with the murder weapon.
title: 2 gangsters, 1 woman: Love triangle ends with blood on Nagpur street

author: PROSHUN CHAKRABORTY
description: During a recent general body meeting, the Nagpur Municipal Corporation drew attention when it only sung two stanzas of Vande Mataram, reflecting a similar stance taken by the Congress party. This oversight has sparked inquiries about the adherence to the Centre's directive for a complete rendition of the song. Legal protections under the National Honour Insult Prevention Act safeguard the song's significance.
title: BJP-ruled Nagpur civic body sings 2 stanzas of Vande Mataram

author: NALLA RAM BABU
description: A five-year-old UKG student died after an alleged teacher slap at a Visakhapatnam private school. The boy's parents allege the teacher assaulted him for incomplete homework, leading to his death. CCTV footage reportedly shows the teacher slapping the child after he showed an empty slate. The school informed the parents much later, sparking protests and an official investigation.
title: Visakhapatnam UKG student dies after teacher slaps him for incomplete homework

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: University of Adelaide researchers have developed an electrochemical method to turn urea into hydrazine using electricity and sodium chloride. The process can use urea from human urine and wastewater and could offer a greener route to hydrazine, a chemical used in rocket fuels, pharmaceuticals and emerging energy technologies, including research linked to electric vehicle batteries.
title: Scientists turn urine urea into hydrazine for rocket fuel and EV batteries
